author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/44-mobile-app.md — REQ-5, REQ-6, AC-5 + decomposition PR 3.

## Surface
- New crate (assuming Q1 = Tauri): `polaris-mobile/` (workspace member)
  - `src-tauri/` — Rust shell, iOS/Android bridges for push registration + biometric prompt
  - `src/` — Leptos UI subset reusing `polaris-frontend/src/api_client.rs`
- Custom URL scheme: `polaris://callback?session=...` registered in Tauri config + iOS `Info.plist` + Android `intent-filter`.
- Reuses v1 auth backends — no mobile-specific auth path.

## Flow
1. App boot: check for valid session cookie. If missing → present login button.
2. Tap login → `tauri::api::shell::open` with the auth URL → OS browser (ASWebAuthenticationSession iOS / Custom Tabs Android).
3. Browser completes OIDC or ATProto OAuth against the existing backend endpoints.
4. Backend redirects to `polaris://callback?session=<cookie>`.
5. App receives the custom-scheme deep-link, stores the session in OS-secure storage (Keychain iOS / Keystore Android), and the API client uses it.

## Rust-quality notes
- **Session storage uses OS-secure facilities.** iOS Keychain via `security-framework` or Tauri's secure-storage plugin; Android Keystore via the Tauri Android bridge. NEVER write the session cookie to a plain file or NSUserDefaults.
- **The `PolarisApiClient` from v1 is reused verbatim** — same trait, same `wasm` impl (the mobile shell IS wasm if using PWA; Tauri Mobile hosts Leptos in a WKWebView/Android WebView, so the wasm client still applies).
- **Per rust-quality §3 (binary crate-ish)**: app errors flow through `anyhow::Result<()>` at the Tauri command boundary, with structured `tracing::error!` events. Don't `unwrap` user-facing operations.
- **Per `clippy::needless_pass_by_value`**: the deep-link handler takes the URL string by reference; the session token is moved into the OS-secure store, not borrowed.
- The Tauri shell deps must not pull in `tokio-rt-multi-thread` — mobile is single-thread-runtime territory (per Tauri Mobile docs). Use `tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt", "macros"] }`.

## External references
- Tauri Mobile setup: https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/#mobile-targets
- iOS Keychain Rust binding: https://docs.rs/security-framework/latest/security_framework/passwords/
- Android Keystore via Tauri: https://v2.tauri.app/security/lifecycle/#android
- iOS custom URL schemes: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/inter-process_communication/allowing_apps_and_websites_to_link_to_your_content/defining_a_custom_url_scheme_for_your_app
- Android intent-filter for deep-links: https://developer.android.com/training/app-links/deep-linking

## Acceptance (AC-5)
- [ ] OIDC end-to-end on a real iOS device, login completes, app receives session cookie via deep-link.
- [ ] ATProto OAuth end-to-end on Android, same.
- [ ] Session cookie is verifiable in OS-secure storage (Keychain entry inspected via Xcode's Keychain access tool; Android Keystore entry inspected via `keytool`).
